title: Plan & Budget

title: Save & Manage

objectives: Save first instead of saving what is left
Explain why an emergency fund protects goals

title: Understand Investing

objectives: Explain the link between risk and potential return

title: Stay Financially Safe
summary: Spot scams, protect OTPs, PINs and personal data, and choose safe actions.
objectives: Identify red flags in messages and offers
